Pro plan

# A year of extra minutes and features, sold as a bundle on specific SKUs.
Pro is a variant on the TicNote card and TicNote Lite listings — not a separate product handle.

Eligible hardware includes 600 minutes per month. Unbound free accounts include 300 minutes per month. Pro plans add more, for example 2,100 minutes per month on 1-Year Pro listings.
